teredo_server.description: Primary Teredo server hostname or IP address (required for client mode)

teredo_fallback_server.description: Fallback Teredo server hostname or IP address if primary is unreachable

teredo_interface.description: Name of the virtual interface to create for Teredo tunneling

teredo_port.description: UDP port number used for Teredo communication (must match server if custom)

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: debug (most verbose) to error (only critical)

log_file.description: Path to log file (e.g., /var/log/miredo.log); use /dev/stdout for console logging

teredo_cone_nat.description: Assume NAT is cone-type (simpler mapping); set false for symmetric NATs if supported

prefer_teredo.description: Give Teredo-prefixed addresses higher priority when selecting source address

teredo_servers.description: List of Teredo servers with optional metadata (e.g., for redundancy)

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Teredo server

priority.description: Priority for ordering fallback (higher = higher priority)

bind_address.description: Local IPv4 address to bind to (e.g., 192.168.1.100); leave empty for auto-detect

max_associations.description: Maximum number of concurrent Teredo peer associations

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Teredo client entirely
